pages.brief: Nell hovering in the centre of the page with her wings drawn as a soft blur, sunflower yellow against clean pale sky. Show speed with the blur, not lines.
pages.alt: Nell hovers in the centre of the page, her wings a soft blur, sunflower yellow against a clean pale sky.

pages.brief: Nell wearing a ridiculous curly red wig several sizes too big, which has slipped over one eye. She thinks she looks magnificent.
pages.alt: Nell wears a ridiculous curly red wig several sizes too big, slipped over one eye — she thinks she looks magnificent.

pages.brief: Close on the wig itself, bright pillar-box red and lovingly detailed with curls, on a twig like a hat on a stand. Nell inspecting it.
pages.alt: A close view of the wig itself, bright pillar-box red and lovingly detailed with curls, resting on a twig like a hat on a stand, while Nell inspects it.

pages.brief: Nell zipping across the page in a zig-zag with the wig streaming behind her, only just hanging on. Sharp angular movement.
pages.alt: Nell zips across the page in a sharp zig-zag, the wig streaming behind her, only just hanging on.

pages.brief: Nell perched on a sticky jam bun almost as big as she is, front legs deep in the jam. Rich reds and golden pastry.
pages.alt: Nell perches on a sticky jam bun almost as big as she is, her front legs deep in the jam, rich reds and golden pastry.

pages.brief: Pip on a branch with six plump purple figs lined up in front of him, counting them with one wing. Exactly six — draw them countably.
pages.alt: Pip stands on a branch with exactly six plump purple figs lined up in front of him, counting them with one wing.

pages.brief: Nell holding up a small paper quiz card with a big tick on it, front legs in the air in triumph, wig askew.
pages.alt: Nell holds up a small paper quiz card with a big tick on it, front legs in the air in triumph, her wig askew.

pages.brief: Closing page: Nell and Pip on the branch together, the wig now on Pip, jam everywhere, both helpless with laughter.
pages.alt: Closing page: Nell and Pip are together on the branch, the wig now on Pip, jam everywhere, both helpless with laughter.
